MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_WOUND_POWER.desc:
A scar left by the ghosts in Sköfnung.
• Every turn: at the start of its turn, the enemy loses HP equal to its Scars (ignores Block).
• Never fades: unlike Poison, Scars never decrease on their own; they only stack.
• Applying: attack cards give 1 to each enemy they damage while [gold]Sköfnung[/gold] is held; Sköfnung cards give more.
• Burst: the moment they reach 12, the enemy loses a lot of HP and all Scars are removed.
• Removing: only a burst or cards that consume or reduce Scars lower them.
The violet part of the health bar is the HP it will lose next turn.
